designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the National Key Deer Refuge in Monroe County, Florida, to protect the Key deer, in Public Law 85-164, approved August 22, 1957.
designationHistory.note: Signer inferred from the date (Eisenhower was President in 1957); no source here shows his signature. The act authorized acquisition; FWS uses the act's date as the establishment date.
